title: Saharan dust
text: Each year winds carry mineral dust, including phosphorus, from the Sahara across the Atlantic to the Amazon. It helps replace nutrients that heavy rain washes out of the soil.
when: Strongest in winter and spring, when the winds carry the most dust across the Atlantic.
matters: Heavy rain washes phosphorus out of rainforest soil. Dust from the Sahara helps replace part of what is lost.
